target.name: Clippership
target.founder: Nico Cymbalist, Luca Cymbalist, Kai Matsuka

methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $5M total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
Clippership is a Seed-stage maritime technology company that has raised $5M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp set of three private peers in ocean and maritime infrastructure (Standard Subsea, NetworkOcean, and Albacore), with no applicable public comparables in the sector.

The stage-progression method is the primary applicable valuation lens. Using total capital raised of $5M as a proxy for current valuation and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for advancement from Seed to Series A, this approach yields an implied valuation of $12M. This represents the median point in the triangulated range.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $11M to $14M, with a central case of $12M. The relatively narrow band reflects reliance on a single methodological approach rather than multiple independent triangulations. Key uncertainties include the composition and burn profile of the $5M raised (seed tranches vs. pre-seed), the developmental maturity relative to private comps, and the absence of public market reference points for the maritime tech subsector. Investors should weight this analysis accordingly and seek additional color on unit economics and customer traction before finalizing entry terms.
